none: PAS NLM-5CB474: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), commemorative Constantinopolis issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust of Constantinopolis helmeted left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.65gms, die axis: possibly 6
